description: Twelve reusable, manually authored compiler conformance scenarios; not live model results.

cases.input: Write a polite email to my manager to move our Tuesday meeting to Thursday.
manual_checks: Direct writing prompt, not the email itself
No calibration questions or unnecessary methodology

cases.input: Give me an easy lunch recipe using eggs, rice, and tomatoes for two people.
manual_checks: Keep simple and self-contained
Do not add high-impact risk analysis or extra planning

cases.input: Write a Python function that returns True if a string is a palindrome, ignoring spaces and case.
manual_checks: Direct execution-ready coding prompt
Do not demand repository inspection for a self-contained function

cases.input: In my existing React checkout form, typed values disappear on validation errors. Fix the bug and add regression tests.
manual_checks: Ask executing agent to inspect repo first
Call for plan, assumptions, risks before major changes, then proceed as appropriate
Do not invent code paths

cases.input: Move our production Postgres database to another provider without downtime. Plan and perform the migration.
manual_checks: Inspect relevant systems before proposing plan
Stop for approval before major production changes
Discuss risks and rollback

cases.input: Audit the visual design of my beta website on desktop and mobile, especially for users who aren't comfortable with technology. Not the backend.
manual_checks: Respect visual-only scope; no backend audit
Novice and experienced perspectives
Recommend accessibility and responsiveness where relevant

cases.input: Conceptually redesign a travel itinerary presentation so customers feel immersed in the story before booking. No implementation yet.
manual_checks: Design direction and storytelling over code
Avoid forcing implementation files or frameworks

cases.input: Research current funding opportunities for an early-stage AI startup in Gulf countries, including incorporation and eligibility requirements.
manual_checks: Use current primary sources and mark unknowns
Clear region, stage and eligibility criteria
Do not fabricate calls or deadlines

cases.input: Compare two CSV exports of monthly sales and expenses and explain which product lines are most profitable and why.
manual_checks: Specify data inspection before inference
Calculate and surface unknowns; no invented values
Offer relevant decision-oriented output

cases.input: Create a practical support operations plan for a 24/7 SaaS beta launch, including roles, incident response and handoffs.
manual_checks: Provide actionable runbook, responsibilities and escalation
No unrelated engineering implementation

cases.input: Can you validate my startup idea?
manual_checks: Follow exact six-field diagnosis format
Ask only high-value missing information, max three grouped questions
Do not invent the startup idea

cases.input: The idea is a subscription appointment reminder service for small dental clinics. Dental clinic owners pay. Validate whether there is demand before I build it.

context.content: Can you validate my startup idea?
What is your idea, and who would pay for it?

manual_checks: Use information given during clarification
Do not repeat questions already answered
Prompt a feasible validation plan with evidence criteria
